subject.title: fix(gateway): enforce plugin-ownership check in sessions.patch

question: Should this public cross-plugin `sessions.patch` ownership fix proceed as a normal narrow bugfix, or be paused for security-owned disclosure and backport handling?
rationale: The implementation boundary is narrow, but the affected invariant is plugin isolation and the canonical issue already carries explicit maintainer/security-review routing; automation should not choose disclosure or release handling.

options.title: Approve narrow public fix
options.body: Repair the head, preserve the atomic ownership fence, obtain live proof, and review it as a normal public Gateway bugfix.

options.title: Route through security handling
options.body: Pause public landing while security owners decide advisory, disclosure, and backport treatment.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow public fix
